_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Cash Collection Voucher
summary: The Cash Collection Voucher accounts for the transfer of funds between disbursing and receiving offices providing food services under food services contracts.
use_relationship:
The Cash Collection Voucher is used to account for the transfer of funds between disbursing and receiving offices providing food services.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
b. This DID is applicable to the acquisition and performance of food services contracts.
c. This DID supersedes DI-FNCL-80542.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The DD Form 1131 shall be used. (Copies of this Form are available at http://www.dtic.mil/whs/directives/infomgt/forms/index.htm)

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: DD Form 1131 is prepared each time an individual dining facility turns funds in to the control office and each time the control office turns funds in to the accounting and finance office. The names and locations of the disbursing and receiving offices are entered on the forms.

children.title: The activity remitting the funds describes the remittance and gives a detailed description of the purpose for which collections were received and the amount of the collections.
The completed DD Form 1131 serves as a receipt for the transfer of funds.
